note: subset of `figcraft-cli commands --json` (0.15.0) for offline tests

commands.label: Create layer
commands.params: {type: rectangle|ellipse|polygon|star|line|arrow|vector|text|frame|section|component|slice, x?, y? (relative to the parent frame; groups don't count), width?, height?, parent? (id; default: the page), index?, name?, text? | characters? (for text), path? | points? (vector: SVG path data | [[x,y],..]; x/y move their own origin, so the layer's left/top is x/y plus their box's unscaled offset), closed? (vector), props? {node.set keys}, select? (default true)}

commands.label: Text
commands.params: {text | characters, x, y, parent?, index?, name? (default: the first line), width? (fixed width wraps), props? (fontSize, fontFamily, …), select? (default true)}

commands.label: Set properties
commands.params: name, visible, locked, opacity (0-1 or "50%"), blend, x, y (relative to the parent frame; groups don't count), width, height, rotation (degrees), fills (paints or colours; gradients as {type: linearGradient|radialGradient|angularGradient|diamondGradient, stops: ["#hex", ...], from?, to?} too), fill (colour, {$var: variable id or name}, or "none"/null: no fill), strokes, stroke (colour, {$var: variable id or name}, or "none"/null: no stroke), strokeWeight, strokeAlign (inside|center|outside), strokeSides [t,r,b,l], strokeTopWeight / strokeRightWeight / strokeBottomWeight / strokeLeftWeight (one side; turns on individual strokes), strokeCap / startCap / endCap, strokeJoin, miterAngle (degrees: sharper joins bevel; or miterLimit as a ratio), dashes [..], dashCap (none|round|square; null: dashes take startCap and endCap), widthProfile (preset uniform|wedge|taper|eye|rounded|pinch, [[t, scale], ...] or null), brush (preset id, {preset, spacing, sizeJitter, rotationJitter, scatter, seed} or null), cornerRadius (n or [tl,tr,br,bl]), cornerSmoothing (0-1), effects, clip, isMask, layout (null|horizontal|vertical|grid|{...}), gap, crossGap, padding (n or [t,r,b,l]), paddingTop/Right/Bottom/Left, mainAlign (min|center|max, or the auto gaps spaceBetween|spaceAround|spaceEvenly), crossAlign (min|center|max|baseline: first text baselines, horizontal layouts), contentAlign (wrapped lines: auto = packed where crossAlign says | spaceBetween), wrap (rows of a horizontal layout, columns of a vertical one), strokesIncluded (the frame's inside stroke takes up space), reverseZ (canvas stacking: true = first on top), columnGap / rowGap (aliases of gap / crossGap), gridColumns, gridRows, columnTracks / rowTracks ([120 | "1fr" | "auto" | {sizing, value}]), gridColumn / gridRow (0-based cell anchor, null = auto), gridColumnSpan, gridRowSpan, gridAlignH / gridAlignV (a grid child's alignment in its cell: min|center|max, auto/null = the frame's), sizingH / sizingV (fixed|hug|fill), absolute (ignore auto layout; follows constraints), minWidth, maxWidth, minHeight, maxHeight (null removes), constraints {horizontal, vertical}, grids, exports, characters, fontFamily, fontStyle, fontSize, lineHeight (auto|px|"150%"), letterSpacing (px|"2%"), textAlign (left|center|right|justified), textAlignVertical, textAutoResize (widthAndHeight|height|none|truncate), textDecoration, textDecorationStyle (solid|dotted|wavy), textDecorationThickness / textDecorationOffset (auto|px|"10%" of the font size; the offset runs from the baseline down to an underline's top edge), textDecorationSkipInk (underlines break around descenders), textDecorationColor (colour, or auto/null: the text's), textCase (original|upper|lower|title|smallCaps), paragraphSpacing, paragraphIndent, listStyle (none|bulleted|numbered; with start/end: the paragraphs those chars touch), indentation (list nesting level 0-8, same range rule), listSpacing (px between list items, in place of paragraphSpacing), hangingPunctuation, hangingList (markers outside the box), leadingTrim (vertical trim: none|capHeight), maxLines, features ({tag: bool}, e.g. {"liga": false, "tnum": true}), fontVariations / variationSettings ({axis: number}, e.g. {"wght": 550, "wdth": 85}; null = none), path (a vector's SVG path data: replaces its geometry, keeping the layer, its paints, styles and bindings; width/height in the same call scale it as node.create does; its own box goes at the layer's x/y, or with x/y given, at x + its left edge and y + its top as node.create places it), pointCount, innerRadius, arcStart, arcSweep, arcInner, booleanOperation (a boolean group's operation, or an operand's own; null: the group's), operandOperation (a layer in a boolean group: how it combines with the operands below it; null: the group's), constrainProportions, description, interactions, overflow, pluginData {k: v}

commands.params: {id, fields?: [node keys], outline?: bool (not with fields)}

commands.label: Find layers
commands.params: {root? (strict descendants; default current page), name?, type? (canonical layer type), text?, component? (main component name), limit? (0-10000; default 100)}: every filter must match; name, text and component are case-insensitive substrings, type is exact (any case); returns {ids, total} and does not select

commands.label: List fonts
commands.params: {family? (list its styles), style?, features? (the face's OpenType features), axes? (the face's variation axes and named instances)}

commands.label: Rescan installed fonts
commands.params: {}  walks the system font folders again, for fonts installed while the app runs; the open document's auto-sizing text in the families that gained faces (new ones, or styles installed since) fits them (text.refit) → {added: [families that were unknown], refitted: [ids]}

commands.label: Load font file
commands.params: {path | data (base64)}  adds a font file (.ttf, .otf, .ttc, .otc; every face of a collection) to this session's fonts without installing it; the open document's auto-sizing text in its families fits it (text.refit) → {families, refitted: [ids]}

commands.label: Missing fonts
commands.params: {}  fonts the open document names that aren't installed (text layers, styled ranges, text styles, font family variables); the app shows them → {families: [{family, layers, source (the font store source font.download gets it from, or null)}]}

commands.label: Fit text to fonts
commands.params: {ids? (these layers and the text in them; default: the whole document)}  auto-sizing text measures its box again, e.g. a box measured in a fallback font while its family was missing → {refitted: [ids whose size changed]}

commands.label: Create variable collection
commands.params: {name, modes? [names]}

commands.label: Add mode
commands.params: {collection, name, from? (mode id or name to duplicate; default: the default mode)}

commands.label: Create variable
commands.params: {collection, name, type: color|number|string|boolean, value (default mode) | values {modeName: value}, description?}  a value may also be {alias: variable} (same type); a colour value may also be {alpha: {variable, opacity 0..1}} (that variable's colour with its alpha replaced by the opacity) or {mix: {from, to, t}} (operands {variable: variable} or {literal: colour}; t is 0..1, 0 gives from and 1 to; blended per channel over the stored values, in the document's colour profile, including alpha; converting the profile keeps a mix's ends exact and moves its colours in between slightly), each alone in its object

commands.label: Set variable value
commands.params: {variable, mode? (name or id; default first), value | {alias: variable} (same type, no loops) | {alpha} | {mix} (colour variables; shapes as in variable.create; no loops)}

commands.label: Delete variable
commands.params: {variable} (bound layers keep their values; variables aliasing it take its values; colour calculations reading it keep the colour they show)

commands.label: Bind variable
commands.params: {ids?, field (fill|stroke (first paint)|fills/<i>/color|strokes/<i>/color|fills/<i>/stops/<j>/color (gradient stops)|effects/<i>/<offsetX|offsetY|radius|startRadius|spread|color>|layoutGrids/<i>/<size|count|gutter|offset>|componentProperties/<name> (instances: boolean/text properties; variant properties take string variables naming a value)|width|height|opacity (percent)|cornerRadius|gap|paddingHorizontal|characters|visible|fontSize…; list indices bottom first), variable (null unbinds)}

commands.label: Set variable mode
commands.params: {ids? (frames/page), collection, mode (id or name; null: Auto, inherited from the parent)}

commands.label: Edit variable
commands.params: {variable, name?, description?, scopes? ([scope ids]; null or ["ALL_SCOPES"] = every supported property, [] = hidden from pickers), hiddenFromPublishing? (left out when the file is published as a library), codeSyntax? {WEB?, iOS?, ANDROID?: name code uses ("" clears)}}

commands.label: Duplicate variable
commands.params: {variable} → {id}

commands.label: Rename mode
commands.params: {collection, mode, name}

commands.label: Delete mode
commands.params: {collection, mode} (a collection keeps at least one mode)

commands.label: Move mode
commands.params: {collection, mode, to (index; 0 = the default mode, layers on Auto follow it)}

commands.label: Rename collection
commands.params: {collection, name}

commands.label: Delete collection
commands.params: {collection} (with its variables; bound layers keep their values; variables elsewhere aliasing them take their values and colour calculations reading them keep the colour they show)

commands.label: Reset variable override
commands.params: {variable (a variable of an extended collection inherited from the collection it extends), mode? (id or name; every overridden mode when omitted)}  the value follows the inherited one again

commands.label: Extend collection
commands.params: {collection (id or name of a collection of this file), name? (default "<name> (extended)")}  → {id}: a collection with its modes and variables that follows its edits (an extended collection can be extended again); override their values per mode with variable.set (variable.resetOverride goes back to the inherited value)

commands.label: Export variables
commands.params: {collections? [ids or names; default every collection of this file, not library copies], format? (json (default): the local variables JSON that variable.import reads, colour calculations as the colour they show in each mode with other collections in their default modes | css: custom properties, the default mode on :root and each other mode on [data-<collection>="<mode>"], colour calculations as the colour they show in that mode with other collections in their default modes; numbers in px unless layers or scopes use them as opacity or font weight | tailwind: a Tailwind CSS v4 stylesheet, the default mode as an @theme block named the way inspect.code's tailwind utilities read them: --color-*, --radius-*, --text-*, --spacing-*, --font-*, unique per file; each other mode as in css; colour calculations as the colour they show in that mode, other collections in their default modes) | dart: a Dart file for Flutter, a class of constants per collection and mode (Color, double, String, bool), aliases and colour calculations resolved), path? (write it there)}  → {text}, or {path} when written

commands.label: Import variables
commands.params: {variables (the local variables JSON, as variable.export writes it: an object, JSON text or a path to a regular file of at most 256 MiB; `variableCollections` and `variables` under `meta` or at the top level)}  collections join this file's collection of the same name (values by mode name; new modes and variables are added, a variable of another type is skipped), others are added  → {collections (added), variables (added), updated, warnings (also when it holds no variables, or fewer than its collections list)}

commands.label: Create component
commands.params: {ids?}  (one frame/group becomes a component; several layers are wrapped in one)

commands.label: Create multiple components
commands.params: {ids?}

commands.label: Combine as variants
commands.params: {ids? (main components; none already a variant, a library copy or inside an instance)}  (wraps them in a new component set; names without `=` become "Property 1=Default", "Property 1=VariantN")

commands.label: Add variant
commands.params: {id? (component set, variant, or a main component not in a set yet: it becomes a set of itself and the new variant), property?, value?}  (duplicates the variant; `property`=`value` names the new one)

commands.label: Create instance
commands.params: {component (component or set: its default variant), x?, y?, parent?}

commands.label: Place instance
commands.params: {component, x, y (page point: the instance is centred there, inside the frame under it; auto layout frames insert by position)}

commands.label: Expose nested instance
commands.params: {id? (an instance inside a main component), exposed? (default true)} — its properties then show on the main's instances

commands.label: Exposed nested instances
commands.params: {id? (instance)} → the nested instance copies whose properties it exposes

commands.label: Make slot
commands.params: {id? (a frame inside a main component), name? (the slot property's name; the frame's by default), preferred? [component or set ids]}  (its instances take any content there)

commands.label: Remove slot
commands.params: {id? (a slot frame of a main component)}  (instances lose their own content in it)

commands.label: Insert into slot
commands.params: {id? (a slot inside an instance, or the instance with `slot`), slot? (slot property name), component, index? (child index; on top when omitted), replace? (clear the slot first)}

commands.label: Reset slot
commands.params: {id? (a slot inside an instance, or the instance with `slot`), slot?}  (back to the main's default content)

commands.label: Hide when publishing
commands.params: {ids? (components, sets or layers in them; default the selection), on? (default: toggle, hiding unless all are hidden)}  keeps them out of the library this file publishes, the way a name starting with `.` or `_` does: hiding puts a `.` before the name, showing takes the leading `.` and `_` away → {ids, hidden}

commands.label: Detach instance
commands.params: {ids?}

commands.label: Reset all changes
commands.params: {ids?}

commands.label: Reset override
commands.params: {id?, group? (fills|strokes|effects|opacity|visible|name|corners|characters|textStyle|padding|gap|alignment|grids|exports|interactions|size|position|modes|component|props|slot; all when omitted)}

commands.label: Go to main component
commands.params: {id?}

commands.label: Push changes to main component
commands.params: {id?}

commands.label: Restore main component
commands.params: {id?}  (an instance whose main was deleted becomes the main again, in its place)

commands.label: Swap instance
commands.params: {ids?, component}

commands.label: Swap instance at point
commands.params: {component (component or set: its default variant), x, y (page point)}  swaps the instance there (preferring one showing the same component set; Alt-drop from the Assets panel); only text layers keep their overrides (by matching names)

commands.label: Set instance properties
commands.params: {ids?, properties {name: value}} (variant properties switch variants)

commands.label: Add component property
commands.params: {id? (component, set, or a layer inside a component: it gets bound), name, type: boolean|text|instanceSwap|variant|slot, default? (boolean: the bound layer's visibility in the main; without it, the layer's current visibility), layer? (node bound to it; a frame for slots), preferred? (instance swap and slot properties: component or set ids offered first)}

commands.params: {id? (component or set), name, newName?, default? (variant properties: that variant takes the top-left place; boolean: the main's bound layers show or hide to match), value? + newValue? (rename a variant value), index? (variant properties: move to this place; the variants' names follow), preferred? (instance swap and slot properties: component or set ids offered first)}

commands.label: Delete component property
commands.params: {id? (component or set), name}

commands.label: Bind layer to property
commands.params: {layer?, property (null/"" unbinds), field?: visible|characters|mainComponent|slot}

commands.label: Component properties
commands.params: {id? (component, set or instance)}

commands.label: List components
commands.params: {} → [{id, name, type, page, instances, folder (the Assets panel's folders: page, frames, slash names), label, library?}]

commands.label: Component playground
commands.params: {id? (an instance, a component or a component set; default the selection), properties? {name: value} (variant, boolean, text and instance-swap properties, as instance.setProperties takes them), language? css|html|react|leptos|vue|swiftui|compose|arkui|flutter (default react), path? (write the preview there as a PNG), scale? (the PNG's, default 2)} → {component, properties: [{name, type, options?, value}], language, code, width, height, path?}  the component with those property values, tried on a copy: its code and its look. Nothing in the document changes

commands.label: Fit text to its box
commands.params: {ids? (text layers; default the selection), maxLines? (default: no limit but the box height), minSize? (smallest font size, px; default 60% of the current), orphans? (avoid a one-word last line; default true)}  needs a fixed width (fixed or auto-height text)  → {fitted: [{id, fontSize, lines, fits, orphan}]}
